# Gate fixtures

Generated by `gen-fixtures.sh` from `tests/fixtures/scan/live38`; every
tree is tracked. One line per variant:

- base: healthy tree with ftrace on, full privilege, lockdown none.
- ftrace-off: ftrace_enabled reads 0.
- ftrace-denied: ftrace_enabled is fixture-denied.
- ftrace-malformed: ftrace_enabled holds non-numeric text.
- aff-dup: the map hook listed twice in available_filter_functions.
- aff-module: the map hook listed once with a module suffix.
- aff-clone: only a dotted clone of the map hook listed.
- aff-prefix: the map hook plus a longer name, no trailing newline.
- debugfs-root: tracefs tree moved under /sys/kernel/debug/tracing.
- debug-denied: debugfs tree present but fixture-denied at its parent.
- lockdown-conf: lockdown file selects confidentiality.
- lockdown-integrity: lockdown file selects integrity.
- lockdown-nosecfs: no securityfs, cmdline raises confidentiality.
- lockdown-dashdash: lockdown parameter hidden after --.
- lockdown-config: boot config forces confidentiality.
- lockdown-nolsm: boot config has no lockdown LSM.
- lockdown-twobrackets: lockdown file with two bracketed tokens.
- lockdown-bogus: cmdline carries an unknown lockdown value.
- lockdown-denied: lockdown file is fixture-denied.
- notracing-config: boot config without CONFIG_FTRACE.
- notracing-bpfevents: boot config with CONFIG_FTRACE=y only.
- tracefs-noevents: events removed under a mounted tracefs.
- tracefs-unmounted: empty tracing dir, mounts without tracefs.
- tracefs-hidden: events removed, no securityfs, no mounts table.
- tracefs-gone: no tracing tree anywhere.
- events-denied: the events dir is fixture-denied.
- btf-absent-config: no BTF, config proves a BTF-less build.
- btf-absent-unknown: no BTF and no config source at all.
- btf-not-visible: no BTF although the config enables it.
- btf-denied: the BTF file is fixture-denied.
- btf-split: BTF whose strings need a base blob.
- btf-truncated: BTF cut to 600 bytes.
- hook-absent: BTF without the map hook, kallsyms without it.
- hook-not-in-btf: BTF without the map hook, kallsyms with it.
- hook-clone: only a dotted clone of the map hook in kallsyms.
- hook-nokallsyms: BTF without the map hook, no kallsyms file.
- denied-all: eight gate paths fixture-denied at once.
- container-view: debug-only tracefs, BTF hidden, config says BTF.
- format-denied: the swiotlb_bounced format file is fixture-denied.
- id-absent: ready-validated tree without the tracepoint id file.
- cc-flags-nonode: SEV-SNP flags with hypervisor, no guest node.
- cc-tdx-nonode: tdx_guest flag with hypervisor, no guest node.
- cc-flags-host: SEV-SNP flags without hypervisor (bare metal).
- cc-tsm: cc-flags-nonode plus a TSM report directory.
- caps-none: CapEff zero (no BPF privilege).
- caps-bpf-perfmon: CapEff with CAP_BPF and CAP_PERFMON.
- caps-sysadmin: CapEff with CAP_SYS_ADMIN only.
- caps-malformed: CapEff with a non-hex value.
- caps-short: CapEff with a short hex value.
- memcg-small: leaf memory.max 1 MiB.
- memcg-ancestor: tight 50 MB ancestor above an unlimited leaf.
- memcg-malformed: leaf memory.max with non-digits.
- memcg-huge: leaf memory.max with 21 digits.
- memcg-empty: leaf memory.max empty.
- memcg-v1: cgroup file with a v1 line only.
- unpriv-bpf: unprivileged_bpf_disabled reads 2.
- swiotlb-noforce: cmdline adds swiotlb=noforce.
- swiotlb-inactive: sys/kernel/debug present without swiotlb.
